lines.text: I'm in this phase of life.
I'm in my baking era right now.

data.mean: I'm in this phase of life.
data.define: Used playfully for a current phase or interest.

example.text: I'm in my baking era right now.

misuse.text: Don't say 'my era' about a history class.
misuse.why: It means a personal life phase.

publish.title: What does "era" mean?
publish.value: Era = I'm in this phase of life. Example: "I'm in my baking era right now." (very casual English, US).
